figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Bengaluru holds the densest cluster of biotech, pharma-R&D, and genomics companies in India - Biocon and Syngene are both headquartered here, alongside a large diagnostics and bioinformatics-services scene. Entry-level bioinformatics analyst pay in Bengaluru averages roughly Rs 6.25 LPA against a Rs 3.4-6.3 LPA national entry range, a real city premium for the same job title, and similar premiums show up across QC, regulatory, and research-associate postings.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Hyderabad's Genome Valley cluster concentrates vaccine, biologics, and generics manufacturing, so production/process-engineer and QC-QA pay here trends close to Bengaluru and generally ahead of smaller hubs. Reported biotech-engineer pay bands in Hyderabad commonly run Rs 4-10 LPA depending on function and experience, similar in shape to Bengaluru's range.

figures.source: Delhi-NCR carries more weight in regulatory affairs, medical/scientific sales leadership, and government-institute research (DBT-linked centres such as the Regional Centre for Biotechnology, ICGEB) than in large-scale manufacturing. Reported biotech-engineer pay bands in Delhi-NCR run roughly Rs 4-11 LPA, competitive with Bengaluru at the upper end for these specific functions.

figures.source: Entry pay across biotechnology careers spans a huge range - a BSc research associate starts near Rs 2.5-5.5 LPA, a CSIR/UGC-JRF stipend runs about Rs 37,000/month, and a government scientist entry post (ICAR/CSIR) works out to roughly Rs 9-11.6 LPA gross once allowances are added.
